_meta.name: Tinkr Design Tokens
_meta.description: The single source of truth for Tinkr's design tokens. Consumed by the Tauri shell, the docs site, the marketplace, the KB viewer, the marketing site, and (via codegen) the Python CLI. Edit a value here, and every surface updates.
_meta.naming_convention: Category → Role → Variant. Lowercase, kebab-case, dot-notation in Style Dictionary, CSS-variable-notation in the output. Examples: color.brand.primary, color.text.primary.dark, spacing.4, motion.duration.base.
_meta.color_format: All hex values are 24-bit sRGB. The 256-color and 16-color ANSI fallbacks are in 03.terminal-palette.md and the Python source in tinkr/cli/style.py — those are not duplicated here.
_meta.usage_style_dictionary: Run `style-dictionary build` to generate platform outputs. The default config in style-dictionary.config.js transforms to: css, scss, js, json, android (xml), ios (json).
_meta.usage_tailwind: Use the tailwind plugin (`@tokens-studio/tailwindcss-style-dictionary` or run style-dictionary to build tailwind.config.js). The tokens will appear as `text-brand-primary`, `bg-surface-base-dark`, `p-4`, etc. See the README for the exact mapping.
_meta.usage_css_variables: Build with `style-dictionary build --platforms css`. Output: `dist/css/variables.css`. Import in your root CSS file. Variables are namespaced: `--color-brand-primary`, `--spacing-4`, `--motion-duration-base`.
_meta.usage_python_cli: Build with `style-dictionary build --platforms json` and consume from `tinkr/cli/tokens.py`. The Python module is auto-generated and provides typed access (BrandColor.PRIMARY.value).
_meta.light_dark_strategy: Light and dark are siblings at the same level (`color.text.primary.dark` and `color.text.primary.light`). The application picks the active set at runtime via the `data-theme` attribute on `<html>`. The default is dark.
_meta.accessibility: All color pairings are verified to meet WCAG 2.1 AA. See 02-visual-identity.md §3.6 for the full contrast table.

primary.description: Brand primary. 'Circuit cyan.' Used for the wordmark on dark surfaces, links, focus rings, brand emphasis. Never body text on light surfaces (fails contrast).

primary-dim.description: Brand primary dim. Pressed and active states for primary. Also used as the focus ring color on light surfaces.

accent.description: Brand accent / CTA. 'LED amber.' The 'ship it' color. Used for primary CTAs, the LED dot in the mark, success-adjacent emphasis, deploy confirmations.

accent-dim.description: Brand accent dim. Pressed and active states for the accent.

secondary.description: Brand secondary. 'Code violet.' Used for the agent surface, KB entries, AI-related elements. Separates the human-built (cyan) from the agent-built (violet).

secondary-dim.description: Brand secondary dim. Pressed and active states for the secondary.

dark.description: Default dark surface. Near-black. The canvas.

raised-dark.description: Raised dark surface (+1 from base). Cards, panels.

sunken-dark.description: Sunken dark surface (-1 from base). Code blocks, terminal panes.

light.description: Default light surface. Off-white, slightly warm.

sunken-light.description: Sunken light surface. Code blocks, terminal panes.

subtle-dark.description: Hairline dark border. Separators, table row dividers.

default-dark.description: Default dark border. Card borders, input borders.

strong-dark.description: Strong dark border. Hover, active borders, focus-adjacent borders.

subtle-light.description: Hairline light border. Separators, table row dividers.

default-light.description: Default light border. Card borders, input borders.

strong-light.description: Strong light border. Hover, active borders, focus-adjacent borders.

primary-dark.description: Primary dark text. Body, headings. 18.6:1 on surface.bg.dark (AAA).

secondary-dark.description: Secondary dark text. Captions, helper text. 7.0:1 on surface.bg.dark (AAA).

tertiary-dark.description: Tertiary dark text. Disabled, placeholder. 4.6:1 on surface.bg.dark (AA).

inverse-dark.description: Inverse dark text. Text on light surfaces (e.g., label on amber button).

primary-light.description: Primary light text. Body, headings. 18.7:1 on surface.bg.light (AAA).

secondary-light.description: Secondary light text. Captions, helper text. 7.5:1 on surface.bg.light (AAA).

tertiary-light.description: Tertiary light text. Disabled, placeholder. 4.8:1 on surface.bg.light (AA).

inverse-light.description: Inverse light text. Text on dark surfaces (e.g., label on cyan button).

success.description: Success. Deployed, validated, connected. Use with an icon or text label, never alone.

success-dim.description: Success dim. Hover, active states for success.

success-surface-dark.description: Success surface on dark. Background for success toasts, badges, alerts.

success-surface-light.description: Success surface on light. Background for success toasts, badges, alerts.

warning.description: Warning. Beta features, deprecation notices, slow operations.

warning-dim.description: Warning dim. Hover, active states for warning.

warning-surface-dark.description: Warning surface on dark. Background for warning toasts, badges.

warning-surface-light.description: Warning surface on light. Background for warning toasts, badges.

error.description: Error. Failures, blocking errors, destructive actions.

error-dim.description: Error dim. Hover, active states for error.

error-surface-dark.description: Error surface on dark. Background for error toasts, badges.

error-surface-light.description: Error surface on light. Background for error toasts, badges.

info-dim.description: Info dim. Hover, active states for info.

info-surface-dark.description: Info surface on dark. Background for info toasts, badges.

info-surface-light.description: Info surface on light. Background for info toasts, badges.

sans.value: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
sans.description: UI, heading, body. Inter, with system font fallbacks so a missing Google Font still looks intentional.

mono.value: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
mono.description: Code, terminal, REPL, plugin manifests, chip DBs, KB entries. JetBrains Mono, with system monospace fallbacks.

display.description: Display. Hero headlines on marketing only.

body-lg.description: Body large. Lead paragraphs, intro text.

body-sm.description: Body small. Captions, secondary text, table cells.

medium.description: Medium. UI labels, table headers, eyebrows.

icon-sm.description: Icon small. Inline with body-sm text.

icon-xl.description: Icon extra-large. Hero features, empty states.

control-sm.description: Control small height. Compact buttons, table cells.

control-md.description: Control medium height. Default buttons, inputs.

control-lg.description: Control large height. Primary CTAs. Meets 44 px touch target.

logo-mark.description: Symbol mark height. Default in headers.

none.description: No radius. Reserved for tables, code blocks.

full.description: Full radius. Pills, avatars, the LED dot.

hairline.description: Hairline. Default for separators and most borders.

none.description: No shadow. Default for most surfaces.

sm.description: Subtle. Cards on raised surface. Used sparingly.

focus.description: Focus ring. 2px primary + 2px surface offset. High contrast, accessible on any surface.

led-glow.description: LED glow. Used on the brand mark LED dot in marketing contexts only. Never in product UI.

instant.description: No animation. State changes that should not animate.

fast.description: Fast. Hovers, focus, small state changes.

slower.description: Slower. Page transitions, large layout shifts.

led-pulse.description: Tinkr. The brand LED animation. Suppressed under reduced motion.

standard.description: Standard. Material 'standard' curve. Default for one-way transitions.

emphasized.description: Emphasized. For important transitions (modal open, page change).

symmetric.description: Symmetric. ease-in-out. For open + close pairs only.

raised.description: Raised. Sticky headers, tooltips that need to escape local stacking.

sticky.description: Sticky. Sticky table headers, side panels.

popover.description: Popover. Tooltips, command palette, popovers that escape modals.

toast.description: Toast. Notifications, alerts. Always on top.

disabled.description: Disabled. Interactive elements in disabled state.

hover.description: Hover dim. Alternative to color shift for subtle hovers.

led-dim.description: LED dim. The brand mark LED at its off state in the 1 Hz pulse animation.
